headline: Iran warns Gulf states it will hit energy sites if US strikes
summary: Tehran told Gulf leaders any new US attack would trigger retaliation against their oil, power and water infrastructure, sources say.
script: Iran has warned Gulf states that any new American attack will trigger retaliation against their oil, power and water infrastructure. The threat comes as Tehran pushes a diplomatic campaign to stop further strikes, with tensions still high across the region.
imageAlt: Zolfaghar missiles on a launcher displayed at Azadi Square in Tehran.
imageAltTwo: A tanker transits the Strait of Hormuz, a critical shipping route.
